BRISTOL ONCOLOGY CENTRE
Date: 14/08/2024

Re: Mr David Thompson
DOB: [redacted]
NHS No: [redacted]

Dear Mr Thompson,

Thank you for attending clinic on 12/08/2024. This letter summarises our discussion regarding your rectal adeno and ongoing treatment.

BACKGROUND
You were dx 03/2022 with rectal adeno, T3N1b stage IIIC. Also hx of basal cell carcinoma left temple excised 2019, no recurrence. Molecular testing showed RAS wt, BRAF wt. Initial tx Apr-Jul 2022 long-course chemoRT (capecitabine + 50.4Gy) followed by APR 09/2022. Path confirmed ypT2N0 with good response. Commenced adj FOLFOX 11/2022.

TREATMENT HISTORY
Completed 8 cycles FOLFOX by 05/2023. Cycle 6 developed grade 2 neuropathy, dose reduced 80%. Stopped after C8 due to persistent paraesthesia both hands. CT 06/2023 showed PR, no mets. Discussed at MDM for IDEA trial but excluded due to neuropathy. Surveillance CT 11/2023 stable. CT 04/2024 showed slowly progressive pelvic LN (12mm to 18mm) and new 8mm lung nodule RLL. Biopsy confirmed recurrent rectal adeno. MDM 05/2024 discussed PARADIGM trial but pt declined. Started FOLFIRI + cetuximab 06/2024 (2nd line).

CURRENT STATUS
Now completed 4 cycles. Cycle 3 developed grade 2 rash, managed with doxycycline and emollients. Recent CT 08/2024 shows PR - pelvic LN reduced 18mm to 11mm, lung nodule stable 8mm. No new mets confirmed. CEA dropped 87 to 34.

You report improved energy levels, able to walk 2 miles daily. ECOG PS 1. Some ongoing fatigue but manageable. Denies pain, wt stable at 76kg. Appetite good.

COMORBIDITIES
T2DM on metformin, HbA1c 52. HTN on ramipril, well controlled.

PLAN
Continue FOLFIRI + cetuximab, aiming 8-12 cycles total. Repeat CT chest/abdo/pelvis in 8 wks. Monitor CEA monthly. Dermatology r/v for rash management. Discussed possibility reintroduction to trial discussion if CR achieved. Will review in clinic 6 wks.

Yours sincerely,

Dr Rebecca Singh
Consultant Medical Oncologist
